name: Will I need drywall repair when replacing my vanity?

mainEntity.name: Will I need drywall repair when replacing my vanity?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, replacing a vanity often reveals unfinished drywall or plumbing rough-ins that require repair. Old vanities are frequently caulked or glued to drywall, which can tear the paper facing during removal. If the new vanity has a different profile or shorter backsplash, exposed areas will need patching, taping, and texturing. Bay City Remodeling & Bathrooms provides complete drywall installation and repair services, ensuring the wall surface behind and around the new unit is clean, even, and properly sealed against moisture.
acceptedAnswer.description: Drywall patching is often needed if the old vanity was glued to the wall or if the new vanity leaves previously hidden, unfinished wall sections exposed.
